model: Frozen seed42 CFCD-S1 global plus trained auxiliary128; no training or parameter selection

gallery.condition: clean original gallery, unchanged across corruptions

queries.selection: Within every Val identity with another relevant gallery image, order image keys by SHA256(salt+key), take at most16; retain original Val row order
queries.sampling: deterministic class-stratified query panel, not full-Val-query evaluation
queries.self_exclusion: exclude original clean image key for every transformed query

corruption_definition.downsample: resize native image by ratio using area interpolation; subsequent original model preprocessing unchanged
corruption_definition.blur: native-pixel isotropic Gaussian blur at stated sigma with reflected border
corruption_definition.asymmetric_margin: prepend left and top margins proportional to original width and height; fill with per-channel median native border; retain all original pixels; combines placement and context changes, not a pure-translation claim

secondary_metrics: changes from the same clean panel
evaluation: float32 stored descriptors -> FP64 normalization and direct squared Euclidean distances; exact-tie expected AP and Hit@1; complete clean gallery; matched self exclusion
uncertainty: paired identity bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed20261113; conditions on fixed model, fixed query panel and gallery; no full-training-randomness claim
paper_location: Section 5.7; Figure 6; Supplement R and Table S23
